 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (virtual/physical) mode.

2. Mr. T.J. Pani, learned counsel for the Appellant is directed to serve two extra copies of the Memorandum of Appeal upon the learned counsel for the State by Monday (18.03.2024) for its service upon the victim in her name and address as would be so supplied with the copy of the application.

3. On receipt of the same, learned counsel for the State would do well to send the same to the IIC of the concerned Police Station for its due service with necessary information that the matter is likely to be listed for hearing in the week commencing 10th July, 2024; when she can raise her objections in this Appeal as also in the matter of grant of bail to the Appellant and further for the purpose if she requires the assistance of a legal counsel of her choice, she may approach the nearest Taluk Legal Services Committee/ District Legal Service Authority to avail that facility/s.
4. List this matter on 10th July, 2024.
5. A free copy of this order be handed over to the learned counsel for the State for onward action.
(D. Dash) Judge (V.Naraginsh) Judge // 2 // ORDER 15.03.2023 16.

1. This is an application under section 389 Cr.P.C. for suspension of execution of sentence imposed upon the Appellant, namely, Prabhakar @ Pravakar Gouda, by the Trial Court while convicting him for the offence under section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and section 3(2)(v) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act by the learned Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Rayagada in C.T. Case No.159 of 2014 and his release on bail pending disposal of this Appeal.

3. Taking into account the submissions made and on going through the judgment passed by the Trial Court as well as the depositions of the prosecution witnesses further keeping in view the surrounding circumstances; when it is seen that earlier the Appellant being granted with the interim bail has surrendered in time and no such report as to his adverse conduct during the period has come to be received; we direct that the Appellant, Prabhakar @ Pravakar Gouda, be released on interim bail for a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of his actual release from custody on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge,
Rayagada in C.T. No.159 of 2014 with further conditions that the Appellant shall not indulge himself in any criminal activity during the period of interim bail; shall not threaten or terrorize the victim and shall positively surrender before the Trial Court as would be so directed by the said Court on expiry of period of interim bail.

4. List this matter on 10th day of July, 2024.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
